gloss: to hurt, to ache, to feel pain

definitions.gloss: to hurt, to ache, to feel pain

examples.japanese: {歯|は}が{痛|いた}むので、{歯医者|はいしゃ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: My tooth was aching, so I went to the dentist.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}のつらい{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて、{胸|むね}が{痛|いた}んだ。
examples.english: Hearing my friend's painful story, my heart ached.

notes:
{痛|いた}む is an intransitive verb meaning to feel pain or ache.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Related: {痛|いた}める (transitive, to hurt/injure)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {頭|あたま}が{痛|いた}む (head hurts)
- {胃|い}が{痛|いた}む (stomach hurts)
- {傷|きず}が{痛|いた}む (wound hurts)
- {心|こころ}が{痛|いた}む (heart aches - figurative)

DISTINCTION FROM {痛|いた}い:
- {痛|いた}い: adjective describing pain sensation
- {痛|いた}む: verb indicating ongoing/developing pain
